author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I got my posture report visiting chiro.   That seems pretty easy for AI to clone, I feed the report pdf to Opus 4.7, give it a 2 pages long prompt on roughly what I want. 2 hours later, Opus one shot a fully functional website analyze posture using ML visual model.

BTW, GPT-5.5 totally failed.  First, it stuck by asking me stupid questions.  Then it gave me a non-functional mock up.  Now it is still trying hard to get it done as I am typing this post

Here is the repo
https://lnkd.in/gWST7yun
